StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ShouldScaleInMultiplayer.rationale: Multiplayer-only scaling (MultiplayerScalingModel). Out of scope; the sim is single-player.

AfterDamageReceived.issue: Right hook and right slot; the threshold matches exactly (`target != base.Owner || result.UnblockedDamage <= 0 || target.CurrentHp > base.Amount -> return`, PlowPower.cs:30, vs powers.py:1297-1300). Three divergences. (1) The sim ADDS `self.owner.is_dead` to the early-out (powers.py:1297) where C# has no such guard -- recurring gap shape 8; dormant because the Ceremonial Beast is removed on death and a dead beast's stun is unobservable. (2) C# removes every `TemporaryStrengthPower` INSTANCE first and then `StrengthPower` (PlowPower.cs:35-40); the sim removes only `"strength"` (powers.py:1302). Dormant because TemporaryStrengthPower is unported (`grep -n '^class TemporaryStrengthPower' sts2_rl/powers.py` returns nothing) -- a named-unported-content dormancy, which per binding rule 1 is a dormant gap and not a waiver. (3) The STUN's follow-up state is delegated: C# calls `ceremonialBeast.SetStunned()` then `CreatureCmd.Stun(base.Owner, ceremonialBeast.StunnedMove, ceremonialBeast.BeastCryState.StateId)` and falls back to a bare `CreatureCmd.Stun(base.Owner)` for a non-Beast owner (PlowPower.cs:41-50); the sim calls a single `on_plow_broken()` on the monster if it exists and does NOT stun at all otherwise (powers.py:1303-1305). So a non-Ceremonial-Beast Plow holder is stunned in the game and not in the sim -- dormant, since monsters/glory/ceremonial_beast.py is the only applier -- and the named follow-up state is the same shape as FlutterPower's, which is LIVE (audit/records/power/flutter.json). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: Plow overrides no AfterRemoved, so the observable is identical -- the same mechanism note as power/no_draw's and power/tainted's.

guards.what: Order: strength removal BEFORE the stun on both sides
guards.rationale: PlowPower.cs:35-45 vs powers.py:1302-1305. Load-bearing: the beast must lose its Strength before its telegraphed move is replaced, or the replaced move would be computed against the old Strength.
